description: This file implements the <request-parameters-to-list> element of a custom mini-language within the OFBiz framework. It processes HTTP request parameters, converting them into a list and storing it in a specified environment map entry during method execution.

classes.name: RequestParametersToList
classes.description: A class that parses and executes the <request-parameters-to-list> mini-language element, converting request parameters into list form and storing them in the environment map.

classes.name: RequestParametersToListFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of RequestParametersToList from XML elements.

methods.name: autoCorrect
methods.description: A static method to correct deprecated attribute usage in the XML element during parsing.

methods.name: RequestParametersToList
methods.description: Constructor that validates and initializes the object based on the XML element.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, extracting request parameters and appending them to a list in the environment map.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Creates a string representation of the object, mainly for debugging.
